_about: Controlled vocabulary for fingerprint cards. Every enumerated field on a card must use a key from here, so two builds that made the same choice collide on the same string. Sources: guide-to-prompt/references/domains and shapes, stumping Parts 1, 2, 6.1 and 6.2, determinism-check Gate G, prompt-voice.md section 3. Add a value only when no existing one fits, and add it here before using it on a card.

domains.data-quality-monitoring-alerting: Data Quality Monitoring & Alerting (author-declared new domain, 2026-10-03)
domains.opportunity-sizing: Opportunity Sizing & Decision Support (author-declared new domain, 2026-10-03)
domains.accounting-audit-forensic: Accounting, Audit & Forensic Analytics (author-declared new domain, 2026-10-06)
domains.legacy-biology: Biology, Biostatistics, Epidemiology & Bioinformatics (dropped 2026-08-27, legacy cards only, never draw it)
domains.legacy-other: A build tagged outside the six (legacy cards only, never draw it)

objectives.opportunity-sizing-decision: Opportunity Sizing & Decision Support (author-declared new Axis 1 objective, 2026-10-03)
objectives.data-quality-monitoring: Data Quality Monitoring & Alerting (author-declared new Axis 1 objective, 2026-10-03)
objectives.legacy-retired: A tag that is no longer valid (legacy cards only)

shapes.single-figure: one committed figure with no repeated structural unit (predates the shape library, or the build never had one)
shapes.other: a structure outside the eighteen, with its criteria arithmetic in the design note

gaps.time: Gap 1, the measurement is backward and the decision is forward
gaps.population: Gap 2, the file is not the thing
gaps.objective: Gap 3, the reported metric is correct and is not what the decision is scored on
gaps.rule: Gap 4, nothing in the pack states the decisive rule

patterns.B: the rule recovered from a closed corpus
patterns.none: no A to E pattern carries the decisive rung (name the G-code instead)

generators.G12: absence of record versus record of absence

gate_g.forecasting: a forecast the correctly read past does not pin
gate_g.method_or_model_selection: two defensible methods, the right one pinned by validation or a standard
gate_g.binding_constraint: a budget, capacity or eligibility limit changes the naive pick
gate_g.decomposition_attribution: a correctly reported movement assigned to the right driver
gate_g.signal_vs_noise_or_hold: every candidate fails or the data cannot support a call
gate_g.confirm_surface_read: the reported number is correct and over-correction is the trap
gate_g.etl_conformance: a conformed dataset judged against a contract
gate_g.statistical_rigor: supporting only, never the sole defence
gate_g.legacy_surface_read: a pre-v3 build whose stump was a surface-read rejection (legacy cards only, banned to draw)

decision_types.pick_one_of_n: exactly one of a filed candidate list
decision_types.ranked_slate_under_cap: which candidates make a capped list, in order
decision_types.quantity_figure: one committed quantity (an amount, a count, a rate)
decision_types.allocation_to_total: split a fixed total across buckets
decision_types.schedule_or_sequence: an order or finish period under capacity
decision_types.dial_setting: one threshold or parameter value from an allowed set
decision_types.date_or_period: the period or date something first happens
decision_types.go_hold_or_stop: act, hold or stop, with the hold licensed
decision_types.renew_replace_lapse: a disposition on an existing commitment
decision_types.structural_verdict: a characterisation with no candidate list
decision_types.designation_set: which members get flagged or designated
decision_types.conformed_dataset: a dataset or filing conformed to a contract

calibration_forms.counterparty_acknowledgement: the other side's acknowledgement, dispute or settlement advice
calibration_forms.pilot_log: a pilot or trial log with outcomes
calibration_forms.existing_book_actuals: actuals from the existing book of business
calibration_forms.prior_period_close_out: a prior period's close-out or sunset ledger
calibration_forms.retry_or_revision_log: a retry, resubmission or revision history
calibration_forms.parallel_run_overlap: two sources observed over the same window
calibration_forms.gold_standard_subsample: a verified subsample or audit drill
calibration_forms.closed_decision_corpus: closed determinations, reviews or cases whose rule can be recovered
calibration_forms.realised_outcome_roster: realised outcomes such as attendance, enrolment or completion rosters
calibration_forms.certified_matrix: a certified back-year matrix or table
calibration_forms.physical_verification: scans, surveys, inspections or lot traces
calibration_forms.censored_or_lagged_release: a release that arrives censored or on a lag
calibration_forms.other: none of the above, named in the card's notes (never counts as a collision)

context_artifacts.filed_standard: a filed standard, rule book, policy or contract
context_artifacts.planning_thread: meeting notes, a planning thread or a memo from a colleague
context_artifacts.filed_model: a filed consultancy, vendor or planning model the stakeholder works from
context_artifacts.other: none of the above, named in the card's notes (never counts as a collision)

role_families.portfolio_manager: manages a portfolio of awards, accounts or products
role_families.research_desk: an economist, analyst or research desk
role_families.statistical_office_head: heads a statistical or data office
role_families.field_unit_lead: leads a field, regional or site unit

forums.council_or_assembly: an elected council, assembly or legislature decides
forums.committee_or_panel: a committee, panel or steering group decides
forums.regulator_or_inspector: a regulator, inspector or ombudsman receives it
forums.executive_team: an executive or leadership team decides
forums.funder_or_donor: a funder or donor receives it
forums.customer_or_counterparty: a customer, supplier, carrier, insurer or other counterparty receives it
forums.line_manager_or_team: the requester's own manager or team acts on it, no formal forum
forums.operations_desk: an operations floor or dispatch desk acts on it directly
forums.other: none of the above, named in the card's notes

forcing_events.vote_or_meeting: a vote or a scheduled meeting
forcing_events.statutory_or_regulatory_filing: a statutory or regulatory filing, return or certification
forcing_events.purchase_order_or_contract: a purchase order, contract, renewal or tender
forcing_events.budget_or_appropriation: a budget, appropriation or allocation round
forcing_events.period_close: a month, quarter or year close
forcing_events.cutover_or_migration: a system cutover, migration or go-live
forcing_events.incident_or_complaint: an incident, complaint, outage or recall
forcing_events.shift_or_daily_cycle: the next shift, roster or daily run
forcing_events.other: none of the above, named in the card's notes
